tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la pañca ra nā tha sa dha ka mā ra ka marda ku li sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje zhes bya ba/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las byung ba nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rje btsun chen po'i ṭi ka gur rgyan las bshad pa ltar nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa tshar kha yar song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /tshar gsum/ rang skad cig gis dpal nag po chen por gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can dbu la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tshar gsum/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo khro mo thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gi rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ṭi bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i dbus su nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal nag po chen po la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar g.yas skor du sngags phreng gi bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad gur gyi mgon po'i skur gyur/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byas nas rang la thim pas rang nyid gzi brjid nus mthu rgyas par bsam zhing / oṃ mahā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bdun pa ci nus pa'i mthar/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa hā ri ṇe/ e ṣa/ a pañci ma/ kā lo/ ya di hwaṃ/ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā rī ṇaṃ/ ya di twaṃ/ pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ yi dam/ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sha sa na gang 'grub bzlas so/ /bzlas 'phro 'jog pa na bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad gyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal dang 'byor pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skabs 'dir gtor ma bsngo na/ rang gi mdun du gtor ma spyi dang mthun pa lag len ltar bsham pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/

kye rdor bde mchog gang rung nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du chos skyong 'khor bcas/ gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal bzhin bskyed chog sogs byas la/ rang mgon por gsal ba'i snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros mdun gyi chos skyong rnams la phog pas bdag gi dam tshig nyam chags kyi grib phog pa thams cad bsangs/ mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kha'i 'od zer tshur rang la phog pas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsam la sngags gong bzhin bzlas/ mthar mchod bstod byas nas thun gtor 'bul ba/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med pa yin na rang la bsdu/ smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' brtan par bya'o/ /tshul 'di ṭī ka gur rgyan dang / /bla ma'i gsung sgros la brten nas/ /sa skya'i dge slong ā nan+das/ /bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs lam gyi bar chad rnams/ /nye bar bral nas rdo rje'i sku/ /yan lag bdun ldan mngon gyur te/ phan dang bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /'chi med sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// na mo mañjū badz+rā ya/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gi 'phags ma lha mo sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i taṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa la/

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ ma dag pa'i snang ba mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid tāṃ yig dkar po las ut+pal dkar po tāṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba nye bar zhi bar byas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe'i dngos grub bsdus nas/ ut+pa la'i tāṃ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'chi med lha mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar zhing / lang tsho rgyas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pal dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan zhing / dbu skra mthon mthing ltar gnag pa/ ltag par bcings pa'i g.yon phyogs gyen du brdzes shing g.yas phyogs kyi dpung par ral pa'i lan bu cung zad 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang / sham thabs can/ 'dzum zhing sgeg pa'i cha lugs kyis mdzes pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i tshe'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tāṃ/

mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ tā re tut+tā re/ swā/ rnams kyis bskor ba de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang / 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bhā ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tu t+tā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res nad rnams kun las skyobs/ /sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad la sogs/ /dus min 'chi ba kun zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rnams/ /rgyas shing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rang gi snying kha'i tshe'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar gyur pa'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rang gi tshe'i bar chad zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ sa chu me rlung sogs kyi tshe'i dngos grub thams cad sngags phreng dang / 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung nas tshe'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ rang gi lus bkrag mdangs dang lang tsho rgyas par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci rigs bzlas/ mthar/ oṃ tā re tu t+tā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/

phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi med lha mo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /bdag gi tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma/ /rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis nyer zhi ba/ /yum gyur ut+pal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /spyod lam thams cad du 'phags ma nyid kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ mdo sde klog pa dang / tsha tsha gtoram la sogs dge ba'i bya ba la brtson par bya'o/ /'di ni lha lcam gyis bskul nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsā ba/ /ā nan+da yis myur bar bris/ /dge bas 'chi med dpal thob shog/ ༄༅/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka ho ma bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /tshar gsum/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shad+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir/ zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dwang shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i khrod du pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gang gis thugs rje'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /chags sogs nyes pa'i bud shing kun sreg cing / /bde chen ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang gi rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor/ lte bar rigs drug gi bag chags kyi sa bon dang / tshe thog ma med pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos pas sum mdo'i me sbar des rigs drug gi sa bon dang snying kha'i kaṃ yar ded sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gya ིrnam pas mdun gyi til la thim/ o badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmīn ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mer blug cing / sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ bcom ldan 'das tshe thog ma med pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan dam tshig gi nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces 'di sa skya lo tsās bris// ༄༅/ /dkar cha bzhi gsung rgyun ma bzhugs so// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ṭa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ skad cig gis rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po/ ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhī ṣiñca tu maṃ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhī ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro kha ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñja kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ ār+ya tsa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ d+dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang /

/mtha' bral bde chen khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /srid pa gsum na dges pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i chu klung skem zhing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ /khro rgyal mi mgo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la lha'i bu'i bdud/ phung po'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud la sogs pa/ bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ /gtor ma byin rlabs gong bzhin/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa nān/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa na nān/ he he bha ga wa ti ma hā sa twa/ sarba bud+dha a ba lo ki ni/ mā bi lam+ba/ mā bi lam+ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇa pā ya/ gṛ h+ṇa pā ya/ sarba bi sañca re swā hā/ ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dam bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing / myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ brta li brta li ma hā brta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/

oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma me dang hū lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga'o/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnams dang ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ā gats+tsha ya/ ā gats+tsha ya/ sarba bhur bhu ba phruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gdeng ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phu hūm̐ swā hā/ lan gsum/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad/ gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi nas phan pa dang / zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig nā ga sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he/ tsa le tsa le swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gzugs mdzes kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥsu ru pā ya ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/

pra su tra/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ san+tar pā ya/ san+tar pā ya/ sarba pre tā nān swā hā/ lan gsum/ a pa sa ran+tu/ a ba ta ra ṇi/ prek+ṣi ṇo/ da da mya haṃ/ sarba lo ka dha tu ni/ wā si nān/ pre ta nā ma hā ra mi ti/ 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i yi dwags thams cad la bdag bza' ba bzang po ster gyi glags lta bar byed pa rnams phyir dengs shig bza' ba dang btung ba phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / 'phongs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las sgrol te/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra/ dri ro/ reg bya/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang / bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du char chu dus su 'bab pa/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ mi nad dang / phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba/ dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ 'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam ci byed kyang / ru nga ba dang / phrag dog pa ma mdzad par/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig gzhi bdag chen po khyed rnams la/

/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ chu sbyin ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i gtsug tor can/ /phyag gi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs cing / /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /paṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ dza la mi dam sarba pre ta bh+yaḥswā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas te/ /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrug pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṅka ni kaṅka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni/ trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na/ pra ti ha na/ sarba karmā pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me sa twa nāñca swā hā/ srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams la zas dang skom/ thogs pa med par 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa/ rasmi bhā wa/ ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da dz+wā la ya swā hā/ chu'i sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di la brten nas/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang 'jog po/ nyer dga' bo la sogs pa/ srid pa chu rlung gi bdag po rnams kyi rgyud la/ sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan/ sems kyi yo byad/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang / /rigs drug rnams la zas dang skom/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir lhag pa yi/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang /

/gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang / /sa blar gyur pa gang yin rnams/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ zhes pa 'di tshe'i rig byed brang ti kun dga' don grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal sa skya lo tsa ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis bris pa'o// ༄༅/ /gtor chen zur 'debs mthong ba rang grol bzhugs// rdo rje khro bo rnams la 'dud/ /gtor ma chen po'i zur 'debs ni/ /gang zag gnas dus yo byad dang / /phan yon rnams ni rtse mo'i gzhung / /rtsa ba nyid las shes bya zhing / /cho ga'i gsal byed alpa brjod/ /mdun du phyi lcags ri gru bzhi la/ nang zur gsum rtse mo lho'am/ gnod pa ngos zin na de ngos su bstan pa'i steng dbus su gtor snod che ba man ji lcags sam rdo rje'i stegs la bzhag slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du g.yon nas rim par mchod pa bshams/ g.yas g.yon du chan dang ar+gha mtheb kyu chu ldugs pa po mchod g.yog re re/ slob dpon gyi g.yas dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par bum chog byed mkhan 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed gnyis kas lhan cig rnam 'joms bsgoms/ gzungs ci rigs bzlas/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ de nas bum chog pas bum par lha bskyed bzlas pa byed cing / slob dpon gyis mdun gyi gtor ma chan sogs la dmigs nas/ lag g.yon rdo rje dang bcas snying khar khu tshur bcangs/ g.yas gtor mar bstan dril bu dang bcas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya la mthe bong dkyil du bkug nas srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan pa'i/ chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bya/ sems kyis lag mthil du raṃ dmar po/ de'i steng du a dkar po/ raṃ las me 'bar a zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gtor mar babs par bsam/ sam+bha ra'i sngags bdun re brjod/ lag g.yas phyag rgya sngar gyi de kha phub la mchod pa rnams la rim par reg cing so so'i sngags brjod/

dhar+m+ma ra ṇi bya/ de ltar dkyus bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad song rjes mchod pa rnams dang chan zan ar+gha'i lhag ma thams cad bzlog glud kyi mgor blug kha cig gtor ma cha gsum btang na'ang / slob dpon rtse mos ma bshad cing / phyag len la mi dgos/ slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar nas dpang gzugs rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa brjod/ de rjes bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs sogs tshigs bcad dang / lhug pa'i bden stobs brjod pa'ang dkyus bzhin byas la/ bum chus sna drangs dar rol mo dang bcas brdeg sar sleb pa dang / slob dpon gyi hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyu sde chen po bzhi'i yi dam zhi ba dang / khro bo'i tshogs ji snyed thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang / don dam chos nyid rnam par dag cing 'gyur ba med pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob chos can las 'bras bslu ba med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma rdo rje ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing / las byed 'jig rten pa'i pho nya drag po'i mthu rtsal nus pa can rnams kyis bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ spyir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bar tu gcod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dam pa'i chos la smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byed pa/ khyad par du dgon gnas 'di la gnod par byed pa thams cad dang / sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad nyon cig

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di dang / bzlog glud phung po dang / khams dang skye mched dang / dbang po drug dang / yan lag nying lag don snying thams cad yongs su tshang zhing / gos rgyan sna tshogs pa dang bcas pa 'di khyer la gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor nye bar zhi nas rang rang gi gnas su 'gro bar gyis shig gang dag bsam sbyor ngan pa de dag gi mi gtong na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bor bsnun cing / bskal pa'i mes tshig par gyur cig bdag dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi lus la gnod pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gdon stong phrag brgyad cu nad yams dang dal kha thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa 'khon grib bltas ngan byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig pha rol gyi mthu dang byad kha phur kha mnan gtad 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i rbod gtong thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags dang byad kha rbad 'dre thams cad de nyid rang la bzlog par gyur cig rmi lam ngan pa mtshan ma ngan pa lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skeg ngan/ chags che zhing nyams nga ba bkra mi shis pa thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig gzhan yang sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod byed kyi bgegs/ gza' dang rgyu skar/ rmu dang bdud/ btsan dang gshin rje/ klu gnyan sa bdag rgyal 'gong the rang / dam sri se mo'i rigs kyi gnod byed thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig mdor na bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyon mongs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig mi 'byung bar gyur cig dkon mchog bslu ba med pa dang /

/chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang / /bsrung skyobs mthu dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ sar+b+ba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra t+yaṅgīr gdug pa can thams cad phyir la bzlog phaṭa/ khos/ rak+ṣaḥ bsrungs/ rak+ṣaḥ bsrung bar mdzod/ ku ru swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis rjes mnan la nang du 'ongs te gong du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du phyung na de la mchod bstod bsdus pa byed/ ma phyung ba rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs ltar byas na/ rang nyid la mchod bstod byas la rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod cing / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi bzod gsol dang / ye shes pa phyung na badz+ra muḥ nam mkha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje khro bo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis bya'o/ /'di ni byed mkhan mang na yang / /lag len nor pa mang mthong nas/ /brtse ba'i bsam pas kun blangs te/ don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsā ba/ /ā nan+da yis myur bar sbyar/ /dge ba'i mi shes mun bcom ste/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por shog/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ mgon po dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
